characters.name: Peter Olson
characters.notes: First-person narrator; name revealed only at end

characters.name: Nick Olson
characters.notes: Dominant older brother; factory worker; later convict

characters.name: Olivia Anne Olsen
characters.notes: Aging mother with dementia and high blood pressure; dies in crash

characters.name: Sionna McAllister
characters.notes: English-degree girlfriend; spiritual guide; stabbed by Nick

characters.name: Tony
characters.notes: Pizza parlor boss; surrogate father figure

characters.name: Bob
characters.notes: Nick's stoner friend; later takes Nick's apartment

timeline: Childhood / grade school flashbacks (kickball, Mrs Stark, dad belt beating)
Present Milwaukee adult life: pizza job, Ma care, meet Sionna
Months of dating, yoga, meditation, college start, Nick estrangement
Ma hospital blood-pressure crisis then home
Bar near-fight; Nick almost punches Peter
Nick drunk-drives Ma to church; fatal crash
Ma funeral; Nick hospitalized then charged
Nick confronts and stabs Sionna; arrest
Sionna recovery and breakup ~1 year later
Seven-to-eight years later: Seattle pizza-chain success
Return to Milwaukee; prison visit and forgiveness
withheld_name_or_twist_rules: Do not reveal narrator's first name is Peter until final beat B35 / end credits equivalent
Do not show Nick stabbing Sionna before the confrontation beat after Ma's death arc
Do not reveal Ma's full name Olivia Anne Olsen or exact death date until cemetery / funeral beats
Do not reveal Sionna's surname McAllister until hospital / police report beat
Keep Nick's prison sentence length and parole timing vague until Seattle-return decision
Withhold Seattle success and pizza-chain ownership until post-breakup time jump
Do not confirm Sionna permanently leaves until the February therapy conversation beat

essential_beats.summary: Introduce Nick as feared modern Viking big brother; family history on Kirk Street after dad left
essential_beats.source_evidence: Narrator describes Nick's scars, strength, gym dominance, and living with Ma downtown

essential_beats.summary: Nick's Trans Am, factory job, and protective but controlling role over Ma and little brother
essential_beats.source_evidence: Details of burnt-orange Trans Am, crane work, and visits to check on Ma sleeping

essential_beats.summary: Narrator stuck in pizza job caring for Ma; Nick dismisses college and refuses factory help
essential_beats.source_evidence: Argument that real world needs connections not degrees; narrator feels too old and trapped

essential_beats.summary: Meet Sionna outside pizza place; she trips into him, gives number, fish necklace, pale intense eyes
essential_beats.source_evidence: First encounter; she declines pizza but offers coffee; narrator feels he already knows her

essential_beats.summary: Ma confused about pills and church; narrator escapes to library, checks out Wuthering Heights
essential_beats.source_evidence: Ma glassy-eyed; temporary library card; begins reading Heathcliff/Catherine story

essential_beats.summary: Coffee date at Java Hut; Sionna discusses book symbols; narrator feels awakened and plans dinner
essential_beats.source_evidence: Talk of ghosts, moors, unchanging love that destroys; links to Ma and Nick

essential_beats.summary: Vivid medieval dream of riding with Sionna-like woman in forest and first kiss
essential_beats.source_evidence: Bolts awake sweating; wonders if past life or book bleed-over

essential_beats.summary: Sionna introduces yoga and Buddhist ideas of attachment and present moment; narrator calms
essential_beats.source_evidence: First yoga class humiliation then deep calm; reads Freud and Buddhism books

essential_beats.summary: Nick explodes that Ma missed doctor appointment because narrator was with girl
essential_beats.source_evidence: Fist-clenching rage; slams door; narrator fears physical damage

essential_beats.summary: Ma chest pressure and confusion; doctor sends to ER for dangerous hypertension and dementia
essential_beats.source_evidence: IV meds, Nitro pills, three-day hospital stay; Sionna helps with weekly pill box

essential_beats.summary: Hospital dream: battlefield where Nick stabs narrator after dying man says Save her
essential_beats.source_evidence: Wakes gasping feeling real betrayal by closest family

essential_beats.summary: Home after hospital; Nick mocks nurse role and Sionna; screaming fight ends with Nick slapping narrator
essential_beats.source_evidence: Bastard and pussy insults; door slam; narrator decides Sionna must never meet him

essential_beats.summary: Grade-school flashback: Nick saves narrator from Mrs Stark; later musses hair promising always to take care
essential_beats.source_evidence: Mocking responsibility chant; Nick as alpha sixth-grader; mixed love-hate

essential_beats.summary: Narrator starts community-college English and business; Nick mocks loans and Sionna influence
essential_beats.source_evidence: Bros before hos; mafia-threat story about Donny Amstel; uneasy truce

essential_beats.summary: Saturday night at Joe's; Nick confronts Lindsey's new boyfriend; nearly punches narrator who intervenes
essential_beats.source_evidence: Slow-motion fist; Joe and bouncer; narrator runs to Sionna's arms

essential_beats.summary: Sionna analyzes Nick's self-esteem; they sleep together; angel-from-lake dream protects from giant Nick
essential_beats.source_evidence: Purpose talk; three a.m. wake; climb into her bed

essential_beats.summary: Months of dual life: school, work, Ma care, Sionna cooking and reading; Nick fully avoids
essential_beats.source_evidence: Ma sees narrator as new leader; Sionna becomes family; exhaustion and love

essential_beats.summary: Nick drunk on Jack and Cokes drives Ma to church; fatal crash; Ma dead on impact
essential_beats.source_evidence: Toxicology pending; narrator screams Die you jackass at empty apartment

essential_beats.summary: Funeral arrangements with Sionna; modest casket and St Mary's plot; Father Joseph talk
essential_beats.source_evidence: Few attendees; dirt on lid; narrator only son present

essential_beats.summary: Hospital visit five days later; Nick weak and tearful; narrator coldly blames him and walks out
essential_beats.source_evidence: Chest tube, bruises, vehicular manslaughter fear; no forgiveness yet

essential_beats.summary: Grief montage: cemetery visits, pizza work promotion to deliveries, Tony as surrogate dad
essential_beats.source_evidence: Ma marker 2 Timothy verse; dream of pregnant Sionna with pizza-faced baby sparks delivery idea

essential_beats.summary: Bob visits parlor with news Nick may be locked up; narrator erupts he is not okay with any of it
essential_beats.source_evidence: Sionna massages neck and advises not to trip over things behind you

essential_beats.summary: Shift to Nick POV in hospital and after: blames Sionna for everything; waits for lawyer
essential_beats.source_evidence: Rants about high-and-mighty doctors, bus losers, and brother becoming Mr High and Mighty

essential_beats.summary: Nick flashback protecting little brother from bully John Johansson; dad belt-beating memory
essential_beats.source_evidence: Threat to hang kid from goalpost; later dad snaps belt for calling brother motherfucker

essential_beats.summary: Nick takes bus to Sionna duplex; corners her, chokes, switchblade threat for money and breakup
essential_beats.source_evidence: Demands cash and no more contact or friends will kill parents; knife to collarbone

essential_beats.summary: Peter bursts in; struggle; knife sinks into Sionna; Nick elbows brother and flees wiping blade
essential_beats.source_evidence: Red flying; bus home with bloody hand in pocket

essential_beats.summary: Peter applies pressure, calls 911; paramedics; police; Sionna survives shoulder and lung wounds
essential_beats.source_evidence: Blood-soaked; officers to Nick's house; hospital wait; parents credit him for saving her

essential_beats.summary: Months later blank Sionna; therapy talk; she cannot feel herself and needs break at parents
essential_beats.source_evidence: February Sunday; she leaves; Peter free-falls into void; finishes degree alone

essential_beats.summary: Seven years later Seattle: owns Tony's Boy's Pizza chain; gray weather; lonely walks; barista Chris
essential_beats.source_evidence: Belltown store; misses Sionna; still hates Nick; yoga class on gratefulness

essential_beats.summary: Dream of Indian sage and dirty pizza box; instruction to stop judging and create reality
essential_beats.source_evidence: Wakes free and joyful; writes notes; decides must see Nick and forgive

essential_beats.summary: Books flight; returns Milwaukee; old apartment alley, former parlor now cosmetology school
essential_beats.source_evidence: Hollow chocolate-Santa sadness; laughs at former career ceiling

essential_beats.summary: Chance deli reunion with aged Bob; he took Nick apartment and factory job; proud of Peter
essential_beats.source_evidence: Bear hug; Bob stopped prison visits because too sad

essential_beats.summary: Drive-by Sionna old duplex; porch memory of Smiley cat and air kiss; accepts she needs peace
essential_beats.source_evidence: No contact attempts answered; moves forward

essential_beats.summary: Green Bay prison visit; scrawny gray Nick; Peter delivers full asshole indictment then forgiveness
essential_beats.source_evidence: Nick weeps apology; proud of pizza-chain success; last I love you; guard ends call

essential_beats.summary: Airport departure; weight of thirty years gone; whispers own name President Peter Olson; closes Nick and Me
essential_beats.source_evidence: Sends Nick love but will never see him again by choice; floating above throng
